detail.reference: Every variable is nonnegative. On \([0,\infty)\), \(f(t)=2t^2/(1+t^2)\) is strictly increasing, so a three-cycle must be constant (any strict inequality propagates cyclically to a contradiction). Thus \(x_1=x_2=x_3=t\), and \(t(1+t^2)=2t^2\) gives \(t(t-1)^2=0\). The solutions are \(\boxed{(0,0,0),\ (1,1,1)}\).
